cohort: 143 patients admitted to a tertiary care center with a primary diagnosis of major postpartum hemorrhage (blood loss >1000ml), including both booked and referred cases.
finding: Anemia was identified as the major risk factor contributing to PPH, followed by multiparity and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Among the 143 PPH cases, 54 were associated with vaginal deliveries and 89 with caesarean sections.
